name: Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine
notes: 450 seats; the Rada's own pages list 392 People's Deputies on 2026-11-04 (itd.rada.gov.ua/struct/Structure/MPs), so 58 seats are shown as vacant (seats in territory not under government control and deputies who withdrew; the Rada does not split the 58). Factions and groups as on its Deputy Factions page; 'Repair of Ukraine' is that page's name for the group. Ninth convocation, no elections under martial law.
